Class TimeoutLayer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.Layer
org.apache.opendal.layer.TimeoutLayer
public class TimeoutLayer extends Layer
Applies deadlines to control operations and individual I/O calls. When a deadline expires, the layer cancels the in-flight call and reports an OpenDAL error. Add this layer before RetryLayer to apply the deadline to each attempt. Use builder() to set timeouts for individual operations.

    • withOperationTimeout

      public TimeoutLayer withOperationTimeout(TimeoutLayer.Operation operation, Duration timeout)
      Returns a new layer with a timeout override for the specified operation. The override replaces the control operation default for operations such as stat and rename. For read, write, list, delete, copy, and compose, it replaces the I/O default for each individual I/O call and concurrent I/O task. Each call replaces the previous override for the same operation.
      Parameters:
      operation - the operation whose timeout to override
      timeout - the timeout, which may be zero
      Returns:
      a new layer with the specified override
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the duration is negative or exceeds Long.MAX_VALUE nanoseconds
